text: {"bodies": ["Not to spread gossip, and it's probably nothing, but I heard someone wondering aloud if Aino Virtanen (e11) might have something to do with those leaked documents. There's zero actual proof of course, likely just people letting their imaginations run wild.", "Did you catch the latest rumour floating around the floor about the document leaks? A few people are quietly speculating it could be Kalle Lehtonen (e02), though honestly nobody has anything concrete to back that up. Wild how fast names start getting tossed around based on pure guesswork."]}
